metrics.description: The score measuring how quickly the visible parts of a page are rendered. Calculated for load actions that are marked as key user actions.

metrics.displayName: Visually complete - load action (by key user action, browser) [web]
metrics.description: The time taken to fully render content in the viewport. Calculated for load actions that are marked as key user actions.

metrics.displayName: Visually complete - XHR action (by key user action, browser) [web]
metrics.description: The time taken to fully render content in the viewport. Calculated for XHR actions that are marked as key user actions.

metrics.displayName: Error count (by key user action, user type, error type, error origin) [web]
metrics.description: The number of detected errors that occurred during key user actions.

metrics.displayName: User action count with errors (by key user action, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The number of key user actions with detected errors.

metrics.displayName: JavaScript errors count during user actions (by key user action, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The number of detected JavaScript errors that occurred during key user actions.

metrics.displayName: JavaScript error count without user actions (by key user action, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The number of detected standalone JavaScript errors (occurred between key user actions).

metrics.displayName: User action rate - affected by errors (by key user action, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The percentage of key user actions with detected errors.

metrics.displayName: Action count - custom action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The number of custom actions.

metrics.displayName: Action count - load action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The number of load actions.

metrics.displayName: Action count - XHR action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The number of XHR actions.

metrics.displayName: Action count (by Apdex category) [web]
metrics.description: The number of user actions.

metrics.displayName: Action with key performance metric count (by action type, geolocation, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The number of user actions that have a key performance metric and mapped geolocation.

metrics.displayName: Action duration - custom action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The duration of custom actions.

metrics.displayName: Action duration - load action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The duration of load actions.

metrics.displayName: Action duration - XHR action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The duration of XHR actions.

metrics.displayName: Actions per session average (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The average number of user actions per user session.

metrics.displayName: Session count - estimated active sessions (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The estimated number of active user sessions. An active session is one in which a user has been confirmed to still be active at a given time. For this high-cardinality metric, the HyperLogLog algorithm is used to approximate the session count.

metrics.displayName: User count - estimated active users (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The estimated number of unique active users. For this high-cardinality metric, the HyperLogLog algorithm is used to approximate the user count.

metrics.displayName: User action rate - affected by JavaScript errors (by user type) [web]
metrics.description: The percentage of user actions with detected JavaScript errors.

metrics.displayName: Apdex (by user type) [web]
Apdex (by geolocation, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The average Apdex rating for user actions that have a mapped geolocation.

metrics.displayName: Bounce rate (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The percentage of sessions in which users viewed only a single page and triggered only a single web request. Calculated by dividing single-page sessions by all sessions.

metrics.displayName: Conversion rate - sessions (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The percentage of sessions in which at least one conversion goal was reached. Calculated by dividing converted sessions by all sessions.

metrics.displayName: Session count - converted sessions (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The number of sessions in which at least one conversion goal was reached.

metrics.displayName: Cumulative Layout Shift - load action (by user type) [web]
metrics.description: The score measuring the unexpected shifting of visible webpage elements. Calculated for load actions.

metrics.displayName: Cumulative Layout Shift - load action (by geolocation, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The score measuring the unexpected shifting of visible webpage elements. Calculated for load actions.

metrics.displayName: Cumulative Layout Shift - load action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The score measuring the unexpected shifting of visible webpage elements. Calculated for load actions.

metrics.displayName: DOM interactive - load action (by browser) [web]
metrics.description: The time taken until a page's status is set to "interactive" and it's ready to receive user input. Calculated for load actions.

metrics.displayName: Session count - estimated ended sessions (by users, user type) [web]
metrics.description: The number of completed user sessions.
